name: Homework & Grades
description: Kids log assignments and grades by subject. Adults see a grade summary per child.

active.sql: SELECT * FROM app_homework_grades__assignments WHERE status IN ('pending', 'submitted') ORDER BY (due_date = ''), due_date ASC, created_at DESC

graded_page.sql: SELECT * FROM app_homework_grades__assignments WHERE status = 'graded' ORDER BY due_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

source.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_homework_grades__assignments WHERE status = 'pending' AND due_date <> '' AND due_date <= date(:today, '+7 days') LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS id, title AS title, subject AS subtitle, due_date AS when_at, member_id AS member_id, (status != 'pending') AS done FROM app_homework_grades__assignments WHERE due_date = :today LIMIT 20
